text.p: Sega of America, a division of Sega Enterprises Ltd, said Wednesday that it has lowered prices on its Sega Saturn and Sega Genesis video game consoles and on Sega Saturn titles.
Sega said the price drop follows the May 31 completion of a "Buy Two, Get One Free" coupon offer.
The new hardware pricing structure is as follows:
Sega Saturn is now $149.99, a $50 reduction, and Sega Saturn with game is $169.99, a $60 reduction.
Sega Saturn Net Link Solution Pack prices were cut $200 to $249.99 and Sega Saturn Net Link was cut $100 to $99.99.
Sega Genesis is now $79.99, a $20 reduction.
Sega said it also reduced pricing on more than 30 Sega Saturn games into the range of $19.99 to $39.99.
